audit.whatIsWrong: Page rates this HARD 8/10 while the win rate is 50.08% over 593 games and every prose line describes Brand winning the lane.
audit.why: Naafiri's threat range is short — Eviscerate is a 450-range dash and Darkin Daggers 900 — against Brand's 1050 Sear and 900 Pillar of Flame. The difficulty comes from her all-in, not from lane presence.
audit.corrected: Left the rating alone (see notes/question) but re-grounded the don'ts and cooldown fields in her actual ranges and timers.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike framing is right: level 3 E-Q, level 6 Pyroclasm through the pack, Liandry's into her sustain.
audit.why: Pyroclasm bounces up to 5 times off Brand and nearby enemies, and her packmates are nearby enemies, so her dive adds bounce targets. Hounds' Pursuit is 110/95/80s and the recast grants a shield — that is her real spike.
audit.corrected: dosFull[2].d and breakdown.carry rewritten onto the packmate-bounce interaction; cooldowns field given her real numbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: The stun was credited to 'a fully-stacked Conflagration mark' and her sustain to 'Diving Bite' — neither exists.
audit.why: Brand's stun is Sear (Q, 8/7.5/7/6.5/6s) and only on an already-ablaze target; Conflagration (E) applies Blaze but does not stun. Naafiri's sustain ability is Eviscerate (E, 11/10/9/8/7s), which dashes 450 units and fully heals her recalled packmates.
audit.corrected: spikes[0].text, spikes[2].text and wants.you[1] rewritten with the real names.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit in it.
audit.why: Hounds' Pursuit 110/95/80s, The Call of the Pack 26/24/22/20/18s, Eviscerate 11/10/9/8/7s are all in the kit.
audit.corrected: Rewritten with the numbers and the window they open.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing told you the Hounds' Pursuit recast shields her, or that The Call of the Pack makes her untargetable.
audit.why: _missing flags the shield absorbing your burst window; the kit adds untargetable on W (26s at rank 1) and on E, both of which eat a timed Pyroclasm.
